diff --git a/packaging/libsigc++.spec b/packaging/libsigc++.spec
index ed0c499..bbe5c19 100644
--- a/packaging/libsigc++.spec
+++ b/packaging/libsigc++.spec
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 Name:           libsigc++
 Version:        2.12.1
 Release:        1
@@ -14,6 +20,10 @@ BuildRequires:  libxslt-tools
 BuildRequires:  doxygen
 BuildRequires:  m4
 BuildRequires:  python3
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
+BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 This library implements a full callback system for use in widget
@@ -37,6 +47,10 @@ developing applications that use %{name}.
 cp %{SOURCE1001} .
 
 %build
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 %meson \
     -Dmaintainer-mode=true \
     -Dbuild-deprecated-api=true \

CommitDate: Fri Sep 4 12:01:04 2026 +0800

    packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
    
    Use libc++ only when the Base Toolchain selector resolves to Clang. Keep GCC and non-toolchain builds on their existing standard library. The shared library may not retain a libc++.so dependency when all used facilities are inline; its Clang command line and std::__1 ABI symbols verify the selection.
    
    仅在 Base Toolchain 选择 Clang 时使用 libc++；GCC 与非工具链构建保持原行为。模板内联可能使动态库不保留 libc++.so 依赖，实际编译命令与 std::__1 ABI 符号可确认选择已生效。

 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+)
